units.source_text: 源氏正在悲伤，看了这信百感交集，

en.t: Genji was already grieving, and when he read this letter, a flood of feelings overwhelmed him,

units.source_text: 回想当年秋天悼亡之事，不胜眷恋之情，

en.t: as he thought back to that autumn years before, when he had mourned the dead, he could not hold back his longing,

units.source_text: 眼泪纷纷落下，揩拭也来不及。

en.t: tears fell one after another, faster than he could wipe them away.
In a spare moment, he wrote a poem in reply:
